title: The traceability chain is persona to story to design to code
statement: Every story applies to one or more personas. Only adjacent links are declared, and every longer path is inferred, so coverage is eventual and always visible.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Only adjacent links are declared: a story names its personas, a design addresses a story, an Item references code.
Every longer path, code to persona or persona to code, is inferred, never authored.
Each link is present, missing, or stale, and status reports which.
Adding a persona creates a visible gap: no story serves it.
Removing a persona leaves the stories that served only that persona as a single question: retire them, or reassign them.
